chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding the mention of the Day of Sacrifice and the description of the sacrificial animal.

As for what follows, indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has designated for people days by which they recognize what is permissible for them and what is forbidden to them. He has made for you in them your rituals (manasik) which are the symbols of Allah. He has made for you in them days to remember Allah's favors upon you, and He has made for you in them days to recognize the limits of Allah, and He has made for you in them days to be mindful of Allah, your Lord.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Day of Sacrifice in Shia tradition according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) elucidates that the Day of Sacrifice serves as a divine institution to manifest the piety of Abraham (Ibrahim) and establish the rites of Hajj, thereby transforming physical rituals into spiritual nourishment. This sermon highlights how these designated times allow believers to internalize divine limits (hudud) and cultivate taqwa, turning the commemoration of the Prophet's sacrifice into a continuous practice of obedience and gratitude.

en.sayed-ali-raza: On the description of the Day of Sacrifice (Id al-Aḍḥa) and the qualities of the animal for sacrifice
